FIR No: FIR/TEST/9081/2026

Complainant Meera Nair reported a cyber fraud near MG Road, Kochi on 14-09-2026. She stated that suspect Arjun Rao contacted her using phone number +91-9876543210 and induced her to transfer Rs. 75,000 via UPI to account 987612345678. Witness Kabir Singh saw Arjun Rao leave in a blue vehicle bearing registration KL-07-AB-4321. Inspector Neha Menon recorded the complaint and seized the transaction receipt for investigation.
